verdict.summary: The change consistently documents the coverage push-to-main exemption and adds a non-vacuous structural regression test. The frozen `needs` sets match the current workflow for all three demoted coverage jobs; additions of a conditional upstream job are detected directly, while new dot-syntax `needs.<job>.…` references in job-level conditions are also rejected. This complements the existing behavioral event-envelope assertions and covers the load-bearing workflow shape described by the design. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff. I could not execute the test locally because PyYAML is absent from the review environment, but the assertions and current workflow inputs were inspected directly.
